``choose`` downloads the candidate (it must be a JPEG or PNG passing the size
filters), keeps it in the art store and queues the job that sets it; ``skip`` lets
the album go on without a cover, ``fail`` fails it.

Ask the profile's cover providers (or ``providers``) at once; candidates, provider
states and the ranked result arrive as ``covers.candidate``, ``covers.provider`` and
``covers.done`` events on the profile's stream.

Add an image of the user's own as a candidate of provider ``upload``. The body is
JSON with the image base64-encoded; it may be at most the profile's
``covers.max_bytes`` once decoded.

get.description:
run.started / run.finished across all runs (API-9), plus the review-level and

post.description:
Answer an import decision, once; a worker job imports the folder (IMPORT-UI-8,
-11). The result arrives as ``job.finished`` and ``import.resolved``.
Look the folder up again by release ids or by artist and album (IMPORT-UI-9).

``retry`` queues the worker job that plans the album again and, when nothing
conflicts any more, moves it at once; ``fail`` fails the album's lane.

ones are left alone (REVIEW-QUEUE-7).

them (DASHBOARD-7). The report arrives as ``job.finished`` on the run's stream.

JOURNAL-6). The result arrives as ``job.finished`` on the run's stream. ``force``
names moved files to undo although they changed (LIBRARY-MOVE-15).
